summary: Switched index live's data source from niftyindices' own live-blob feed to nseindia.com's /api/allIndices.
reason: niftyindices.com's iislliveblob.niftyindices.com/jsonfiles/LiveIndicesWatch.json was found, via a direct fetch bypassing this CLI, to serve a stale snapshot frozen months in the past across every index in the feed. nseindia.com's allIndices endpoint reflects the actual last trading session.
validated_outcome: Confirmed live via direct CLI invocation that returned a current-session timestamp instead of the prior frozen one.
